_real_world.variant_scope: T56-A-427A as fitted to E-2D Advanced Hawkeye (twin-engine installation, 5,100 shp each)
public_equipment: 2 x T56-A-427A, 5,100 shp each (CSG order-of-battle page, csg-us-navy-e2d-navair)

_provenance.modeling_note: T56-A-427A is a free-turbine turboprop, not a thrust-producing jet engine; the Engine record schema (src/content/unit_definition_loader.cpp) only parses mil_thrust_n/ab_thrust_n/sfc_mil/sfc_ab/bypass_ratio (thrust-in-newtons fields), with no shaft-horsepower concept. mil_thrust_n/ab_thrust_n here is an engineering_estimate equivalent static thrust derived from the sourced 5,100 shp rating using a generic propeller static-thrust approximation (T[N] ~= 4.0 x shp, a coarse low-speed conversion factor used only to populate this jet-shaped schema; NOT a real turboprop performance figure). ab_thrust_n is set equal to mil_thrust_n since the T56 has no afterburner. bypass_ratio is set to 0.0 (not applicable to a turboprop; proxy placeholder, not a claim of a real bypass ratio).

engine.mil_thrust_n.note: 5,100 shp sourced (A, OOB page); converted via T[N]=4.0*shp proxy factor since the loader has no shp field. Not a real thrust figure

engine.ab_thrust_n.note: set equal to mil_thrust_n; turboprop has no afterburner stage

engine.sfc_mil.note: 0.4690 lb/(hp.h) generic T56-family max-power SFC (Wikipedia Allison T56 performance table); applied as proxy since no -427A-specific SFC found in 2 searches

engine.sfc_ab.note: same generic T56-family SFC figure as sfc_mil (no afterburner stage to differentiate)

engine.bypass_ratio.note: 0.0 placeholder; bypass ratio is not a meaningful concept for a turboprop, field not applicable
